title: Success Rates for First-timer and Second-timer HDB BTO Applicants
what_it_is: Success Rates for First-timer and Second-timer HDB BTO Applicants

sections.label: BTO application success rates
sections.summary: From 2013 to 2015, about nine in 10 first-timer and seven in 10 second-timer families succeeded in non-mature estate BTO applications, and HDB tapered BTO supply.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: As a result, from 2013 to 2015, about nine in 10 first-timer families and seven in 10 second-timer families were successful in their applications for BTO flats in the non-mature estates.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Most flat applicants with multiple unsuccessful applications had applied for flats which are limited in supply but in high demand and these are largely BTO flats in the mature estates as well as balance flats.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: With the demand-supply balance restored, HDB has been tapering the BTO supply – this came down from 22,400 flats in 2014, to 15,100 flats in 2015.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Despite the tapering of flat supply, the application rate of first-timer families applying for 3-room or larger BTO flats in the non-mature estates has remained stable at about 1.6 times last year.

sections.label: HDB 2016 flat supply plans
sections.summary: HDB plans to offer about 18,000 flats in 2016 to meet new demand from higher income ceilings and enhanced Special CPF Housing Grant, monitoring the market.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: HDB plans to offer about 18,000 flats this year in 2016 to meet new demand from recent policy changes, which include the higher income ceilings and enhanced Special CPF Housing Grant.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: We will continue to monitor the market closely and adjust the supply when necessary, in line with our broader plan to keep supply at a sustainable level over the long term.
